description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Mirror Image to return from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Phantom Steed.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Mirror Image leaves the battlefield.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Mirror Image and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
